title: Confirm intent-4: the only DRC marker and LVS open N0 are one 0.5 um ridge gap on the common input, est. 0.3-0.7 dB on all 8 outputs
evidence: rv.drc() (no PDK deck; basic width>=0.25 / space>=1.0) gives exactly 1 marker: LN_RIDGE.space<1.0 at [489.239,-1.0,489.739,1.0]. rv.query shows LN_RIDGE split into [360,489.239] and [489.739,500] (1.0 um wide), LN_SLAB [360,500]x[-5,5] continuous, so the ridge is cut over 0.500 um, slab only. rv.lvs(): design_only net EC#0.P0-MMI#1.P0 (intended N0) is this cut. Loss estimate: 2D x-z Helmholtz solve (TE, 400 nm LN film -> 200 nm slab -> 400 nm, oxide clad, work/rules/s13b_gap2d.py) gives 0.62 dB for a 0.5 um gap (converged with monitor distance); lateral diffraction over 0.5 um in the slab (Gaussian w0 0.66 um from rv.junction_loss offset fit) adds ~0.06 dB. The 2D model overestimates (in the rib part of the mode already sits in the slab), so 0.3-0.7 dB.
impact: Real defect, not a false alarm: 0.3-0.7 dB extra loss on every one of the 8 outputs (common input path).
fix: Draw route_in as one continuous 1.0 um LN_RIDGE straight from x=360 to x=500.

category: broken waveguide (LVS flag, missed by DRC)
title: Confirm intent-3: 10 um of route_l2_2 drawn on LN_SLAB instead of LN_RIDGE (LVS open N14), est. ~6 dB on EC#12 and EC#13
evidence: rv.lvs() design_only net MMI#3.P2-MMI#6.P0. rv.flat(): LN_RIDGE shape is a MultiPolygon [1332.954..1700]x[-127.5,-126.5] with area 357.046 (a full 1 um x 367.046 straight would be 367.046): missing x 1546.846..1556.846. In the gap there is an extra LN_SLAB rectangle [1546.846,-127.5,1556.846,-126.5] (1 x 10 um, the ridge drawn on the slab layer; it overlaps the 10 um slab, so the cut is slab only). Basic DRC misses it because the gap (10 um) is larger than the 1.0 um space rule. Loss: 2D vertical model 0.81 dB (s13b_gap2d.py) + lateral free diffraction over 10 um in the slab (1D Gaussian, w0 0.66 um, n 1.66: zR 1.47 um, T=1/sqrt(1+(10/2.94)^2)=0.28, 5.5 dB) = ~6 dB.
impact: About 6 dB (critical, >1 dB) on the two outputs fed by MMI 5 (EC#12 at y=-63.5, EC#13 at y=-187.5).
fix: Restore the LN_RIDGE straight over x 1546.846..1556.846 at y=-127 and delete the 1 x 10 um LN_SLAB filler.

title: Confirm intent-2: two 0.3 um lateral steps in route_l1_1, local overlap gives 0.90 dB each, ~1.8 dB on the 4 lower outputs
evidence: rv.cross_section(656.9,y,90): ridge at x 656.55..657.55 for y=-82..-173.5 but 656.25..657.25 at y=-81 (bend 1) and y=-175 (bend 2); slab stays centred on 656.75. My slab-vs-ridge check (work/rules/s7_width.py) also flags the asymmetric slab margin [651.75,-169.4,651.95,-86.25]. rv.junction_loss(1.0,1.0,offset=0.3) = 0.903 dB (offset 0.1 -> 0.100 dB, 0 -> 0 dB: quadratic, consistent). Two steps -> ~1.8 dB. Bend radii themselves are 80 um.
impact: ~1.8 dB extra loss on EC#12..EC#15 paths (everything after MMI 2); breaks power balance top vs bottom half.
fix: Move the vertical straight of route_l1_1 back to x centre 656.75 (x 656.25..657.25).

title: Confirm intent-1: EC#13 at y=-187.5, 3.0 um off the 127 um grid; ~17 dB coupling loss to a fibre array
evidence: rv.instances(): output ECs at y 444.5, 317.5, 190.5, 63.5, -63.5, -187.5, -317.5, -444.5 (all x=2700, angle 180). Pitches 127,127,127,127,124,130,127. Intent -190.5. With MFD ~3 um (w0 1.5 um) a 3.0 um offset gives T=exp(-(3/1.5)^2)=0.018, 17.4 dB. The route follows the EC (route_out_5 s-bend offset 58.85 um vs 61.85), so LVS matches; the path to EC#13 is also 1.49 um shorter than nominal (1871.615 vs 1873.10).
impact: Output 5 (EC#13) is effectively dead when a 127 um fibre array is aligned to the other seven.
fix: Place EC#13 at y=-190.5 and re-route route_out_5 with the standard R=80 s-bend (offset 61.85 um).

title: Confirm intent-5: route_out_6 bends are R=25 um; local bend solve 38 dB/cm -> >=0.3 dB, and the EC#14 path is +21.09 um long
evidence: My curvature check over every route ridge polygon (work/rules/s8b_radius.py, circle through vertices i-6,i,i+6 per edge) gives centre-line R 24.9 um for the two 90-deg bends [1776.75,-379.85,1802.25,-354.35] and [1801.25,-342.5,1826.75,-317.0]; every other bend is 80 um (79.3-80.4 within vertex noise) except route_out_1 (100 um). rv.modes(bend_radius=25): TE0 k_eff 1.09e-4 = 38.4 dB/cm; R=80: 0.023 dB/cm. Two quarter turns = 78.5 um of arc -> 0.30 dB radiation, plus 4 straight/bend mode-mismatch transitions not computed. Path total EC#14 = 1894.19 um vs 1873.10 nominal (+21.09 um, rule +-0.5).
impact: ~0.3-0.8 dB extra loss on output EC#14 and a 21 um length (about 0.15 ps) skew against the other paths.
fix: Replace the Manhattan route with the standard R=80 s-bend used by route_out_4/7 (offset 61.85 um).

title: Confirm intent-6: 367 um of route_l2_3 is 0.6 um wide; junction loss only ~0.06 dB but optical-length skew ~6.6 um on EC#14/#15
evidence: Width check (opening of every route ridge piece by 0.498 um, work/rules/s7_width.py) finds only two narrow regions: this one [1332.954,-381.3,1700.0,-380.7] (area 220.228 = 0.6 x 367.046) and the 0.4 um neck of intent-7. Port check: ridge at MMI#7.P0 is 0.600 wide, centred. rv.junction_loss(1.0,0.6)=0.030 dB per step -> 0.06 dB. rv.modes: n_eff 1.7916 -> 1.7416, n_g 2.1898 -> 2.1505: group-delay skew = 0.0393 x 367.05 / 2.19 = 6.6 um of RWG1000 length, phase 2*pi*0.050*367/1.55 = 74 rad. Physical length is unchanged (paths EC#14/#15 sum to 1894.19/1873.10).
impact: Small loss (~0.06 dB plus extra sidewall scattering in the narrow guide), but breaks delay/phase matching of 2 outputs by far more than +-0.5 um.
fix: Draw the straight at the RWG1000 width of 1.0 um.

title: Confirm intent-7: 2 um x 0.4 um neck in route_l1_0, <=0.33 dB on the 4 upper outputs
evidence: Width check finds LN_RIDGE [656.55,136.718,656.95,138.718] (0.40 x 2.00 um, area 0.8) between two 1.0 um straights [656.25..657.25], same centre 656.75. rv.junction_loss(1.0,0.4)=0.167 dB per step (0.4 um still guides TE0, n_eff 1.705) -> up to 0.33 dB for the pair; the neck is short so the real value can be lower. title: Confirm intent-8: route_out_1 s-bend R=100 um, EC#9 path 2.28 um short; no loss impact
evidence: Curvature check: R 99.3-100.4 um on [1776.75,317.0,1921.37,379.85] (all other s-bends 80). Path sums from rv.optical_net_geometry (area/width, corrected for the neck and the gaps): EC#9 1870.821 um vs 1873.10 nominal (-2.28). Larger R only lowers bend loss.
impact: Length rule broken by 2.28 um (~15 fs skew); harmless for power splitting, matters only if the outputs must be phase/delay matched.
fix: Use the R=80 s-bend (as route_out_0/2/3) for route_out_1.
